Tom and Sam had great fun there. Tom hopes to visit Tokyo one day. They took many photos at the bus terminal. What's more, a giant mural brightens the underpass.
There are always many people at the bus terminal. Sam is interested in reading. Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. He wears the red jersey of the home team.
Last Friday, Tom and Sam went to the riverside walk. Tom usually has soup for breakfast. It takes twenty minutes to get to the riverside walk by bike.
